units.source_text: 这个时候突然刮起了一阵狂风，乌云黑压压的笼罩了四周，黑暗被淡紫色闪电从中劈开，雷声交加。

en.t: Just then a sudden gale swept up, dark clouds pressed heavily over everything, the darkness was split open by pale purple lightning, and thunder crashed all around.

units.source_text: 不，不光是电闪雷鸣，倾盆暴雨倾泻而下。

en.t: No, it was not only lightning and thunder; a torrential downpour came pouring down.

units.source_text: 天地变色，宇内震动，杜子春却似乎不害怕的端坐着。

en.t: Heaven and earth changed color, the whole world trembled, yet Toshishun sat upright as if he were not afraid.

units.source_text: 疾风骤雨，雷电交加，就是这巍巍峨眉山，似乎也要瞬间翻天覆地了。

en.t: Amid the fierce wind, sudden rain, lightning, and thunder, even towering Mount Emei seemed about to be overturned in an instant.

units.source_text: 这个时候，雷声轰隆隆，几乎要穿透人的耳膜，

en.t: At that moment the thunder rumbled so violently that it seemed almost ready to pierce a person's eardrums,

units.source_text: 空中翻动的乌云中窜出一条火柱，冲向杜子春头顶。

en.t: and from the churning black clouds in the sky, a pillar of fire shot out and rushed toward Toshishun's head.
